shortDescription: Brazil's oil production rose 13.6% year-on-year in July to a record high of 4.5 million barrels per day, oil regulator ANP said on Tuesday.Natural gas output was up 12.6% to 214.97 million cubic meters per day.

children: Brazil's oil production rose 13.6% year-on-year in July to a record high of 4.5 million barrels per day, oil regulator ANP said on Tuesday.
Natural gas output was up 12.6% to 214.97 million cubic meters per day.
